einzeiler: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over spy scandal, shaking Silicon Valley and national…
kurzfassung: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned following revelations of affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy, sparking national security concerns and fierce debate in Silicon Valley. Meanwhile, Anthropic's upcoming massive IPO and OpenAI's latest financials highlight the explosive growth and intense capital demands of the AI sector. The hosts also discuss recent political developments, including a historic Senate upset in Mississippi, congressional battles, and California's defeated wealth tax.
stichpunkte: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid a major espionage scandal involving a suspected Chinese intelligence asset.
Silicon Valley faces severe criticism for prioritizing shareholder value over national security in the wake of the breach.
Anthropic sets its IPO price range targeting a $1.3 trillion valuation with strong backing from major tech giants.
OpenAI reports surging quarterly revenue alongside multibillion-dollar operating losses as competition intensifies.
California's Proposition 40, a proposed billionaire wealth tax, is defeated following massive opposition spending.
A historic Senate race in Mississippi results in the election of the state's first Democratic senator in over 40 years.
House Republicans block an impeachment effort against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth after several Democrats miss the vote.

clips.hook: Billions wiped out in after-hours trading
clips.text: The sudden drop in share value following the scandal translates to hundreds of billions of dollars vanishing overnight.

clips.hook: A closer look at Anthropic's financials
clips.text: Massive revenue growth contrasts sharply with substantial operating losses as the company prepares to go public.

beschreibung:
Hang up your leather jackets! Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang just resigned, and Kara and Scott are here to break down the national security implications, Silicon Valley’s reaction, and what’s next for Nvidia. Then, they discuss Anthropic’s upcoming IPO, OpenAI’s mounting losses, and California voters rejecting the billionaire wealth tax. Plus, a historic Democratic victory in Mississippi, Pete Hegseth’s impeachment fight, and the latest battle over the Epstein files.
